page_title: STU 2-3 HOF | Stuttgart v Hoffenheim 28/10/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+7' Stuttgart take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
90+6' Stuttgart work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
90+5' The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Stuttgart.
90+4' Angelo Stiller (VfB Stuttgart) commits a rough foul. Felix Zwayer stops the game and makes a call.
90' 6 additional min. will be played.
90' Deniz Undav (VfB Stuttgart) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent.
86' Stuttgart failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
83' Substitution. Silas makes way for Lilian Egloff (VfB Stuttgart).
83' Here comes a substitution. Jovan Milosevic (VfB Stuttgart) is brought on as a substitute for Chris Fuhrich.
80' Chris Fuhrich (VfB Stuttgart) can't expect anything else than a yellow card for his hard tackle. And a yellow it is. Felix Zwayer didn't think twice about pulling it out of his pocket.
78' Pellegrino Matarazzo decides to make a substitution. Maximilian Beier will be replaced by Marius Bulter (Hoffenheim).
78' Substitution. Tom Bischof walks off the pitch and Umut Tohumcu (Hoffenheim) comes on as a substitute.
73' 2 - 3 An unlucky rebound falls to Deniz Undav (VfB Stuttgart) and he scores with a bullet header.
72' Stuttgart take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
71' Dan-Axel Zagadou (VfB Stuttgart) commits a rough challenge and Felix Zwayer blows his whistle for an infringement.
67' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Atakan Karazor leaves the pitch and Woo-Yeong Jeong (VfB Stuttgart) comes on.
67' Here is a change. Pascal Stenzel is going off and Sebastian Hoeness gives the last tactical orders to Jamie Leweling (VfB Stuttgart).
66' 1 - 3 Robert Skov (Hoffenheim) latches on to a sweet pass and scores with aplomb. His shot went in off the right post. Fabulous goal!
65' Tom Bischof (Hoffenheim) hammers the ball towards goal from long-range, but one of the defenders reacts brilliantly to block the shot.
64' Substitution. Anthony Rouault did his best and is replaced by Dan-Axel Zagadou (VfB Stuttgart).
61' 1 - 2 Goal! A precise cut back on the goal line from Deniz Undav finds Chris Fuhrich (VfB Stuttgart) right in front of goal, and he easily buries the ball into the bottom right corner. 1:2.
58' Enzo Millot (VfB Stuttgart) shoots after receiving a good pass. His effort from the edge of the box goes just wide of the left post.
55' What a chance that is! Enzo Millot (VfB Stuttgart) displays good awareness near the penalty spot to get on the end of a cross, but he sends his header narrowly wide of the left post.
52' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Pavel Kaderabek trots off the pitch and is replaced by Ihlas Bebou (Hoffenheim).
51' The referee blows his whistle as Grischa Promel (Hoffenheim) was too aggressive in his challenge.
48' Felix Zwayer couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Angelo Stiller (VfB Stuttgart) and blew his whistle.
46' The whistle blows and Felix Zwayer starts the second half.
45+5' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.

45+5' Maximilian Beier (Hoffenheim) does well to control a poor pass on the edge of the box then shoots towards the middle of the goal. Alexander Nubel is out of position but leaps to make a brilliant save.
45' We will have 5 min. of added time.
41' Chris Fuhrich (VfB Stuttgart) takes the chance to have an effort at goal from inside the box but misses to the right of the target.

40' Deniz Undav (VfB Stuttgart) attempts to convert a cross into a goal, but his promising header from near the penalty spot towards the middle of the net is denied by Oliver Baumann. This effort really didn't trouble him.
37' The current number of shots on goal is 3:3.

33' What a great effort! Pascal Stenzel (VfB Stuttgart) decides to unleash a long-range shot. Despite hitting it very well, it scorches inches wide of the right post. We could have witnessed a magnificent goal.
32' Florian Grillitsch (Hoffenheim) is substituted due to injury. Pellegrino Matarazzo gives a chance to Anton Stach.
31' Deniz Undav (VfB Stuttgart) takes a penalty kick. The shot goes in the direction of the bottom left corner, but Oliver Baumann reacts superbly and stops it, deflecting the ball onto the post!
30' Deniz Undav (VfB Stuttgart) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
29' Oliver Baumann (Hoffenheim) knocks his opponent down with an over-the-top tackle. Stuttgart are awarded a penalty!
29' Hiroki Ito (VfB Stuttgart) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels towards the target, but Oliver Baumann easily deals with the threat.
23' The resulting set piece from Stuttgart is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
21' 0 - 2 Wout Weghorst (Hoffenheim) easily converts the penalty kick as he sends the ball straight into the bottom left corner, ricocheting in off the post. Alexander Nubel was helpless.
21' Wout Weghorst (Hoffenheim) is going to take the penalty!
20' Anthony Rouault (VfB Stuttgart) was probably a bit loose with his words to Felix Zwayer, who decides to show him a yellow.
20' Here comes the VAR decision: PENALTY to Hoffenheim!
20' Referee Felix Zwayer makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether it’s a penalty for Hoffenheim. Let’s see what happens!
20' Maximilian Beier (Hoffenheim) breaks into the box and goes over after a challenge from an opposition player, but the ref signals NO penalty!
17' Today's referee Felix Zwayer rightly decides to book Kevin Akpoguma (Hoffenheim) for his harsh tackle.
16' Felix Zwayer has a clear sight and sees a foul from Kevin Akpoguma (Hoffenheim).
10' Deniz Undav (VfB Stuttgart) jumps for a cross and produces a fine header from near the penalty spot, but it goes a whisker over the bar! What a huge opportunity!
7' Deniz Undav (VfB Stuttgart) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
6' Deniz Undav (VfB Stuttgart) receives a diagonal pass, bursts into the box and shoots towards the middle of the goal. Oliver Baumann is well positioned, though, and it's a comfortable save.
4' 0 - 1 Goal! Grischa Promel (Hoffenheim) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball low inside the left post. It's 0:1.
2' Rough tackle by Wout Weghorst (Hoffenheim). The referee blows his whistle for a foul.
1' The first half has started.
Felix Zwayer will supervise the game today.
